config.script:
selection = event.itemPath
	
	if not selection:
	    return
	
	tree = self.props.items
	
	breadcrumb = []
	current = tree
	node = None
	
	# ---------------- TREE TRAVERSAL ----------------
	for pos, idx in enumerate(selection):
	
	    i = int(idx)
	    node = current[i]
	
	    breadcrumb.append({
	        "label": node.get("label"),
	        "path": "/" + node.get("data", {}).get("path", "").lstrip("/"),
	        "forwardDisplay": pos < len(selection) - 1
	    })
	
	    current = node.get("items", [])
	
	selectedPath = breadcrumb[-1]["path"]
	
	# ---------------- RBAC ----------------
	nodeRoles = node.get("data", {}).get("roles", []) or []
	userRoles = list(self.session.props.auth.user.roles or [])
	
	hasAccess = True if not nodeRoles else any(role in userRoles for role in nodeRoles)
	
	# ---------------- DENY ----------------
	if not hasAccess:
	
	    system.perspective.openPopup(
	        id="accessDenied",
	        view="widgets(templates)/Shared/AccessDenied",
	        params={
	            "message": "Access Denied! You don't have permission."
	        },
	        modal=True
	    )
	
	    # 🔥 CRITICAL FIX: RESTORE SELECTION PROPERLY
#	    if self.session.custom.nav:
#	        self.props.selection = self.session.custom.nav.get("selection")
	
	    return
	
	# ---------------- ALLOW ----------------
	self.session.custom.nav = {
	    "selection": selection,
	    "breadcrumb": breadcrumb,
	    "currentPath": selectedPath
	}
	
	# 🔥 ONLY NOW update selection (important)
	self.props.selection = selection
	
	# navigation
	if self.page.props.path != selectedPath:
	    system.perspective.navigate(page=selectedPath)
	
	# optional
	if selectedPath == "/alarms-management":
	    system.perspective.closeDock("footerDock")
